sourceSection: Section 3.3.2, printed page 79 physical extents; Table 3.1
axisDefinition: Physical maximum extents after alignment to the minimum-inertia X axis; Z is the spin axis.
scaleQualification: The SEPPCoN thermal effective radius is used as a volume-equivalent display radius. This is an explicit scale convention, not a measured volume or set of physical axis lengths.

alternatives.disposition: The 2023 paper reports inertia-equivalent axes. This scene consistently uses physical extents from the thesis, not a mix of both definitions.

qualification: Smooth parameter-based approximation. The original convex mesh has not been obtained; no local shape features, concavities or surface textures are claimed.
